description: Multi-seed calibration of post-bootstrap UDGM transmission-side degradation around the experimentally identified static-rekey transition regime.
interpretation: UDGM SUCCESS_RATIO_TX is dynamically changed only after successful bootstrap; SUCCESS_RATIO_RX remains 1.0.
primary_question: Across multiple Cooja seeds, how does 3-of-3 versus 3-of-5 static coded rekeying behave in the post-bootstrap UDGM TX transition regime?
